summary: feat(settings): add Synced data row and delete modal UI
description:
Because:

- Users need to delete their Sync data from Settings
- Design needs to compare the two proposed delete modals in Storybook

This commit:

- Adds a "Synced data" row to Data Collection, shown only when given devices
- Opens Firefox Sync settings via the sync_preferences web channel message
- Adds the delete modal with warning and sign-out variants
- Adds device mocks, Storybook stories, and modal unit tests

Refs #FXA-14895
